title: #38. Sulh Al Hudaybiyyah Part 2
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا سَهُلَ عَلَيْكُمْ اَمْرُكُمْ

لَا يَدْعُوْنِيْ اِلاَ خُطَّهْ يَعْظُّمُوْنَ بِهَا فَعَلَامَ نُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا اِذَّنْ اَنَا عَبْدُاللهِ وَرَسُولُهْ، لَن أخَالِفَ اَمْرَه’ وَلَنْ يُّضَيِّعَنِيْ

فَعَلَامَ نُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا اِذَّنْ اِلْزَمْ غَرْزَةْ أَنَه، رَسُوْلُ الله Allahعَزّوجَلّ says: إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ

اَجِزْهُوْلِيْ فَظنَّ الرَّجُلُ بِاَبِيْ فَنَفَذتِ الْقَضِّيَّهْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ جَاعِلٌ لَكَ وَلِمَنْ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ ۖ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِهِنَّ ۖ

فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ ۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ ۖ وَآتُوهُمْ مَا أَنْفَقُوا ۚ

وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ وَاسْأَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْأَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقُوا ۚ

ذَٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ ۖ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

وَلَا يَصحُّ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا غَدْرْ لَا يَحِّلُّ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا الغَدْرْ، لَا يَصحُّ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا الغَدْرْ لَقَدْ رَءَى هَذَا ذؤرا وَيْحَ أُمَّهُ

وَيْحَ أُمَّهُ ، مُسَّعِّرُ الْحَرْبِ لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَه’رِجَالْ اِنَّ هَذَا لَسَفَاهة فَرَجَعْتُ وَاَنْا اَظُنْ اَنَّه’ نَزِّلَ فِيْهِ شَيْء

نَزَّلَتْ عليَّ الَّيْلَ سُوْرَةْ هِيَّ اَحَبَّ اِلَيَّ مِنَّ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيْهَا، اِنَّ فَتَحْنَالَكَ فَتْحَا مُّبِيْنَا۝

اَوَ فَتْحً هُوَ إِنْتَصَرنَا فِيْ بَدْر, لَقَدْ كَانَ الْحُدَيْبِيَهْ اَعْظَمَ الْفُتُوْحْ وَذَلِكَ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَآءَ إلَيْهَا فِيْ اَلْفٍ فِيْ اَرْبَعَ مِائة

فَلَمَّا وَقَعَ الصُلْحْ مَشى النَّاسُ بَعْضَهُمْ فِيْ بَعْضْ وَعَلِموا وَسَمِعُوا عنِ الله فَمَا اَرَادَه اَحَدٌ الاسْلَامِ اِلَّا تَمَكَّنَ مِنْهُ،

فَمَا مَضت تِلْكَ السَنَتَانْ اِلَّا وَالْمُسْلِمُوْنَ قَدْ جَاوَزُوْاِ إلَى مِائة فِيْ عَشْرَةَ اَلْفْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا۝

لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا۝

لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا۝

وَيَنْصُرَكَ اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا۝

هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِيمَانًا مَعَ إِيمَانِهِمْ ۗ

وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا۝

وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا۝

وَمَا يَعْلَمُوْ جُنٌوْدَ رَبِّكَ اِلَّا هُوْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; لِيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ

تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا۝

وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ الظَّانِّينَ بِاللَّهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ ۖ

وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَاءَتْ مَصِيرًا۝

وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا۝

إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا۝

لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا۝

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ اللَّهَ يَدُ اللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَنْ نَكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنْكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ۖ

وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ اللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا۝

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), سَيَقُولُ لَكَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَا أَمْوَالُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ مَا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ

قُلْ فَمَنْ يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا۝

بَلْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَنْقَلِبَ الرَّسُولُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنْتُمْ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا۝

وَمَنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَعِيرًا۝

وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا۝

سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا انْطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلَامَ اللَّهِ

قُلْ لَنْ تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا۝

يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلَامَ اللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ لِلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُولِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ

فَإِنْ تُطِيعُوا يُؤْتِكُمُ اللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا ۖ وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا۝

أُوْلِي بأسٍ شَدِيْدٍ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ ۗ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ

وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا۝

لَقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا۝

وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا۝

وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ النَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ النَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ آيَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا۝

وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا۝

وَلَوْ قَاتَلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوَلَّوُا الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا۝

سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِنْ تَنْصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنْ

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنْ تَنْصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنْ بَعْدِ

مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَنْ يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُؤْمِنَاتٌ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَنْ تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُمْ مِنْهُمْ مَعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ

لِيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا۝

إِذْ جَعَلَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ التَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوا أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا۝

لَقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّؤْيَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ آمِنِينَ آمِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ

فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا فَجَعَلَ مِنْ دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا۝

هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا۝

مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا ۖ

سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ

فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمةُ الله وَبَرَكَاتُه’
english:
The Life Of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 2 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki; The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) sent Sohail Ibn Amr(سهيل إبن عمرو) to negotiate with Rasool Allah ﷺ a truce.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ saw Sohail(سُهيل), he said; Your matter has become easy.

Because the name Sohail(سُهيل) is derived from Sahula(سَهُلَا), which means easy.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ took it, as a good omen from the name that Tafa'ul(تفاعل) which is called the Tafa'ul(تفاعل) that peace is on its way, and that Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) are intending on reaching an agreement.

Rasool Allah ﷺ and Sohail Ibn Amr(سهيل إبن عمرو) they deliberated for a while, on the terms of the agreement and they were very insistent, on not allowing Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Sahabah(صحابه) to enter Makkah that year.

They were very persistent on this particular point and this is the zeal of Jahilliyah(جاهلية), and the pride of Jahilliyah(جاهلية), the arrogance of Jahilliyah(جاهلية).

They didn't want people to say that he entered it upon us forcefully, and Rasool Allah ﷺ tried to argue with them, this point to, no avail.

They completely refused.

Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted a settlement, Rasool Allah ﷺ he mentioned before They would not call me, to any plan in which the sanctities are glorified, but I would accept it.

Now, the terms of the agreement were spoken verbally.

So, the only thing left was to write them down.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was very upset with what he heard.

So, he went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said; Aren't you the Messenger of Allah? Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes.

Aren't we, the Muslims? He said, Yes.

Aren't they, the disbelievers.? He said: Yes.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; Then why should we demean our religion then?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) saw this as lowering our status and lowering our position.

You are the Messenger of Allah, so you represent Al-Haqq(ألحق).

They are the Mushrikeen(مشركين), they represent evil.

We are the Muslims, who are followers of Haqq(ألحق).

Why should we bargain with them, and why should we reach an agreement with them, to start with?

This was the understanding, the perception of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب).

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Umar(عُمَر); I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger, I will not disobey Him and He will not abandon me.

Umar(عُمَر) then went to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and said: Isn't he Rasool Ullah? He said: Yes.

Aren't we the Muslims? He said: Yes.

Aren't they, the disbelievers? He said: Yes.

Then why should we demean our religion.

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) said; Follow him, He is the messenger of Allah and Allahعَزّوجَلّ will not forsake him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) later on, would regret, these arguments of his.

Even though, they were, they were made with good intention.

But Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was very sensitive, when it comes to Haqq(ألحق), that's why, he is  called Al-Farooq(ألفاروق).

He distinguishes between right and evil.

And he always submits his desires and his intention is to Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

He does not allow himself to follow, the whims of the Nafs(نفس).

He was a very strong believer, Mo'min Al-Qawwi(مؤمن القوي).

So, he would control himself and he only argued here because of his intentions to give Nusra(نصرة), victory to the religion of Allah.

However, when he saw that the matter, is a matter of revelation that Rasool Allah ﷺ has instructions from Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

He realized his mistake and he said, he would later on, remember this and say; So I have gone on fasting, giving alms, praying and freeing slaves,

because of what I did that day, and out of fear for what I said, that day.

The Good deeds erases bad deeds.

So, if you commit a mistake, if you make a sin.

Do a lot of good deeds, after it, in order to erase that sin.

See Umar(عُمَر) here is saying; I was doing fasting, giving Sadaqah(صدقه), praying voluntary prayer, and freeing slaves and this is one of the greatest deeds to free slaves.

He was doing it to erase that sin.

So, this is what, we should do, because all of us are going to commit sins.

This is our nature.

Therefore, we need to erase those sins with good deeds.

They started writing the terms of the agreement and these terms were; Both have agreed to complete truce for a period of 10 years, during which all the people will enjoy peace and security and will not attack one another.

Next, if anyone from the Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) joins Muhammad(محمد) without permission from his guardian or chief, he shall be returned to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Next, if anyone from the camp of Muhammad(محمد) joins Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), they are not required to return him.

See here, if somebody comes from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), he is returned but if somebody comes from Muhammad(محمد) he is not returned.

This was one of the conditions that were displeasing to the Muslims.

Both sides agree that they harbor good intentions towards each other.

Next, no theft or treachery shall be condoned.

Next, whoever wishes to enter into an alliance with Muhammadﷺ may do so.

And whoever, wants to enter into an alliance with Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) may do so.

And finally, it is further agreed that you Muhammad(محمد) shall return home this year, without entering Makkah.

At the end of one year, we shall evacuated Makkah for you, so that you may enter it with your followers to stay for three days only.

You shall carry only the armament necessary for a traveler, namely your swords in their sheaths, you should not carry any other arms.

They wrote that down and it's time to sign the agreement and have witnesses and suddenly Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) appears.

Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) who is he?

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) he's the son of Sohail(سهيل), who is writing the agreement with Muhammadﷺ.

He fled from Makkah, he was in chains, he was imprisoned in Makkah because of being a Muslim, he heard the news that the Muslims are near, so he made it, walking through the valleys or mountain passes until, he reaches to Al-Hudaybiyya(اَلحُدَيبية).

And finally, he's happy that he's with the Muslim camp.

Sohail Ibn Amr(سُهَيل بن عمرو) see's him and said: This is the first person, who's case I pick up, you must return him to me.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Allow me to have him?

He said: Either this or nothing, if you refuse to give Abu Jandal(أبوجندل), I refuse the agreement.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; We still didn't sign it yet.

Sohail(سُهَيل) was persistent and he refused to back down.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, to Abu Jandal(أبوجندل); You must be returned.

Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) said; O Rasool Ullah you send me back to the disbelievers to test me in my religion.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) be patient and endure your situation for Allah's sake.

He will certainly provide for you, and those who are suffering with you, a way out of your hardship.

We have made a peace agreement with these people, giving them a pledge by Allah that we will be faithful to the terms of our agreement, we should not violate our pledges.

Umar رضي الله عنه was walking next to Abu Jandal(أبوجندل), when he was being dragged away and he was pointing the handle of his sword, placing it, pushing it, next to Abu Jandal(أبوجندل)

with the intention of allowing Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) to pick up the sword and strike his father.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) says; Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) preserved his father and didn't want to kill him.

And the issue was over.

Because Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was whispering to Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) and telling him, these people are disbelievers, they are worthless.

The blood of any one of them, is no more precious than the blood of a dog.

He's inciting him to do something against his father but Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) did not take any action.

To the Sahabah(صحابه) men who had dignity, men who had honor, men who had their full trust in Allah for them to see their Muslim brother taking back to the disbelievers, was disastrous.

This incident of Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) was very difficult for the Muslims to swallow.

Now, Rasool Allah ﷺ only did it because he had a promise from Allah.

Because we don't want anybody to argue and say that, the Muslims could be handed over to the Kuffar(كفار).

This was done because Rasool Allah ﷺ had a promise from Allah.

That Allah will provide them with a way out.

This was not forecasting by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

This was Wahii(وحي), this is a promise.

Allah will provide you with a way out, Allah will provide you with a solution to your problems, but it was very difficult on the Muslims.

So, when Rasool Allah ﷺ ordered the Muslims to slaughter their animals and shave their heads.

No one moved!

Yani(يعني) Rasool Allah ﷺ would just point out his order and they would immediately rush to perform it.

But this time, suddenly no one moved, now some scholars tried to say that, this was not disobedience on part of the Sahabah(صحابه).

They were just delaying a bit, with the hope and expectation that may be Rasool Allah ﷺ would receive a revelation that would change the situation,

and maybe there's still a glimpse of hope, that we might be able to go into Makkah because there were so eager to make Tawaf(طواف).

They came with that intention, now they're going back empty handed.

So, they said maybe, if we wait a bit the situation could change.

Rasool Allah ﷺ went back and was very angry, upset.

And he told Ummo Salamah(اُمّ سلمة); The Muslims are ruining themselves, I have given them an order and they have disobeyed.

Ummo Salamah(اُمّ سلمة), the wise, Umm-Ul-Momineen(اُمّ الْمُؤمنين) she said; Messenger of Allah, Do not talk to them about it, they have been under great pressure

because of all the trouble you have taken to achieve this peace settlement.

And because they now realize that they have to take the long way home without achieving their purpose.

And then she told him: If you want them to follow your order go out and do it in front of them.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ called upon his barber, to cut his hair and then he would slaughter his animals and his camels and then all of the Sahabah(صحابه) immediately performed the orders of Rasool Allah ﷺ

but they were very, very sad and depressed state.

The Muslims returned, the whole Hudaybiyya(حُدَيبِية) thing took about between two weeks, 20 days.

On the way, there were two questions on the mind of the Muslims; 1) First question was, we were promised that we would make Tawaf(طواف), so what happened.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Umar(عُمَر); Did I tell you that you would do it this year.?

Umar(عمر) said: No.

Then Rasool Allah ﷺ told him than you would make the Tawaf(طواف), and 2) Second issue: How can we return the Muslims to them, and Rasool Allah ﷺ said: If we return someone to them,

Allah will provide a way out for them.

If somebody from them comes to us and they're Muslim, we would send them back and Allah will provide them with the way out, but if somebody leaves from us to them,

then Allah has rid us from him.

Why do we want, such a person to remain with us?

Such a person who has given up his Islam and ran away.

Why would we want them to stay with us?

Now, an exception was made to this rule with Muslim woman.

So, Muslim woman are not to be returned.

And there's an Ayah(آية) that was revealed to clarify that issue.

So, is this Ayah(آية) making Naskh(نسخ) of the contract or is it something that is not explicit in the contract and the Ayah(آية) clarifies it?

Allah Ho-Alam(الله اعلم), this Ayah(آية) is in Surah Al-Mumtahina(سورة الممتحنة).

O you, who believe when there come to you believing women, refugees examine and test them, Allah knows best as to their faith.

If you are ascertain that they are believers then send them not back to the unbelievers.

They are not lawful wives for the unbelievers nor, are the unbelievers lawful husbands to them but pay the unbelievers what they have spent on their dour

and there will be no blame on you if you marry them on payments of their dour to them but told not to the guardianship of unbelieving women,

asked for what you have spent on their dour and let the unbelievers ask for what they have spent on the dours of women who come over to you,

such is the command of Allah, He judges with justice between you and Allah is full of knowledge and wisdom.

So, now to the story of Abu Baseer(أبوبصير).

After the agreement was done, a man called Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) who belongs to the tribe of Thaqeef(ثقيف).

Where are the Thaqeef(ثقيف) from?

Thaqeef(ثقيف) are from At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف), but he was an ally of Bannu Zahra(بنوزَهْرَة).

And Bannu Zahra(بنوزَهْرَة), are one of the clans of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) in Makkah.

Abu Baseer(أبوبصير), was a Muslim, he fled from the Mushrikeen(مشركين) and he came to Al-Madina(المدينه).

Three days later, two men came asking for him, to be returned.

One of these men is from Bannu Aamir Bin Loaee(بنوعامر بن لؤئي).

One of the branches of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and the other one was a servant called Kausar(كوثر), who came with him to guide him, And they had a letter, the letter was presented to Rasool Allah ﷺ, Obae Bin Ka'ab رضي الله عنه read the letter

that, we have an agreement between us and you have to turn this man back to us.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) you have to go back.

Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) said; O Messenger of Allah, are you going to send me back to the disbelievers to test me in my religion?

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Abu Baseer(أبوبصير); We have an agreement with these people and it's not appropriate for us to betray.

Betrayal is not allowed in our religion.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is not doing this for the Kuffar(كفار), he's not doing it to please them, he is doing it because these are the rules of Islam.

Even though, the issue relates to Kuffar(كفار).

But these are the virtues and these are the rules of Muslims that we do not betray.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling Abu Baseer(أبوبصير).

We cannot betray, in our religion, in our religion, this is not allowed.

So, the Muslim is bound by the rules of Allahعَزّوجَلّ in his dealing with Muslims and non Muslims.

We follow the rule of Allah in everything that we do.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ told Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) just like he told Abu Jandal(أبوجندل) that Allah will find a way out for you.

Allah will provide you with a way out.

So, now Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) left with these two men.

When they reached to a place called Zul-Khulifah(ذُوالْحليفَة).

There is a Masjid(مسجد) there.

It was Zuhar(ظهر) time, so he, Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) went and prayed two Rak'ah(ركعة) and he had some dates with him.

So, he told the two men, who came to take him, these Mushrikeen(مشركين), he said: Come and join me.

So, they also brought some bread that they had, and they had a meal together.

This Aamiri(عامري) man, he pulled out his sword, in one narration it says that, he pulled out his sword and said; I'm going to use this sort of mine to strike the Aos(أوس) and Khazraj(خزرج) from morning to night.

Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) told him, Is it a good sword?

He said: Yes, it is!. And I have tested it.

Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) said: Do you mind, if I see it.

The moment, the sword was in the hands of Abu Baseer(أبوبصير), the man was dead!

That's in one narration.

And other narration it says; they went to sleep, so Abu Baseer(أبوبصير), his hands were tied, so he pulled out the sword with his mouth and then with his mouth holding the sword, he cut the ropes tying his hands,

and then it struck, this Aamiri(عامري) man and kill him.

So, these are the two narrations, that how he killed Aamiri(عامري).

This second man Kausar(كوثر) when he saw that, he just ran away, flying away, It says in the narration of Al-Waqedie(الواقدي), that rocks would fly, from beneath his feet, that's how fast it was going.

and he also says that he raised his Thaub(ثوب), his dress so high, that his private parts were seen.

I mean, the man was so terrified, he's just flying and he was not running to the direction of Makkah because it's still far away, he was running towards the direction of Madina

and Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) was not able to catch him.

I mean, Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) was running after this man, trying to kill him but the man is terrified.

So, he runs into the Masjid(مسجد) and Rasool Allah ﷺ said: When he saw him.

This man has seen something that terrified him.

They told him: What's wrong with you?

He said: My companion was killed and this man is going to kill me too, and he was seeking their help.

So, they told him calm down! Don't worry!

Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) came in, holding the sword in his hand and he told Rasool Allah ﷺ; O Rasool Ullah, You have fulfilled your pledge to them,

and you have handed me over to them, you have done your part.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And this part is in Al-Bukhari(ألبخاري), it is authentic.

Woe to his mother, he will incite war, if he just had men with him.

The meaning of the statement is that Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) has the capability of starting a war, if he has men with him.

This statement, what Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) understood from it, is that Rasool Allah ﷺ is going to hand them over again, if he stays.

So, he decided that he should leave, he left.

Al-Waqedie(الواقدي) by the way, says that Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) brought, the belongings of Al-Aamiri(ألعامري) to Rasool Allah ﷺ in order to them divide them, according to the rules of Ghaneemah(غنيمه), the spoils of war.

Rasool Allah ﷺ refused to take them and said; If I take them then, this is violating my agreement.

It is up to you, to do with it, what you want and Rasool Allah ﷺ refused to take it.

So, Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) is the one who took, what belong to Al-Aamiri(ألعامري).

Now, Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) he cannot go back to Makkah, he just fled from Makkah and he has killed the man from Makkah.

So, what could he do?

He went to the coast alone.

No one with him, and all what he had with him was a handful of dates and he split up, that small handful of dates and he ate from it for three days and that was the only food that he had.

Al-Waqedie(ألواقعدي) says that Allah provided for him, on the coast fish that would come to the coast, dead fish and he would survive by eating from those fish.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), the story of Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) is amazing.

I mean, a man alone, on the coast with no assistance, with no help, and there is Ya'ani(يعني), they're looking for him, people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and he is that difficult, fearful situation.

How Allahعَزّوجَلّ provided for him, and gave him a way out, and gave him victory.

Abu Jandal(اَبُوجَندَل) heard about that, so he fled from Makkah and joined Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) and then some other believers who were living under the tyrants, fled and they all joined Abu Baseer(أبوبصير).

And this would make Abu Baseer(أبوبصير), the first Muslim to wage a guerrilla style warfare in the history of Islam.

These men started gathering and there is a narration, According to Al-Waqedie(ألواقعدي).

Al-Waqedie(الواقدي) was one of the scholars of Seerah(سيرة), however his narrations do not stand up to the requirements of the Ulema(علماء) of Hadith(حديث).

But he mentions that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) lead a letter writing campaign to the Muslims who were living among the Mushrikeen(مشركين) to join Abu Baseer(أبوبصير).

And he mentioned in the letter that Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Woe to his mother, he would incite war if he just had men.

So, what Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) meant by this, is that you men should join him and fight.

Now, they started executing special operations against the caravans of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

So, the news of these operations started spread around and now man from Ghaffar(غفار) would join them and then men from Johaina(جهينة) and from Aslam(اَسْلَم)

and from the different tribes, all of these young man, who want to join in this fight in this guerrilla warfare were joining with Abu Baseer(أبوبصير).

Until, he had an army of 300 strong, 300 men with Abu Baseer(أبوبصير), and he's leading them in this war against the caravans of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Whenever, they would hear of a caravan of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), they would attack it, take everything in it, and they would execute everyone in the caravan.

Now, the situation became unbearable for Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and Rasool Allah ﷺ didn't do anything, Rasool Allah ﷺ did not involved in this at all,

he did not condemn what Abu Baseer(أبوبصير) was doing, he did not tell him to stop, Rasool Allah ﷺ was responsible for what was happening in Madina,

Now, just an explanation of what the meaning of Fath(فتح) is, and what the meaning of the word Nasr(نصر) is.

Fath(فتح) is opening and it's used in Arabic, the original meaning is used when something is locked and opened, that is Fath(فتح).

So, when a key is put into a lock, and it unlocks it.

That is called Fath(فتح).

This meaning was borrowed, to also mean when a land is open, because the land is locked against the army.

And it's now opened because it's not like you just walk into the territory of the enemy, it's locked, it's locked in front of your face, and you have to fight to open it.

Therefore, the word Fath(فتح) is used to refer to a victory that involves taking over land.

While Nasr(نصر) could be used to refer to victory in a battle.

So for example, if you're talking the victory of Badr(بدر).

You say; we were victorious in Badr(بدر).

But you don't say Fatahna Badr(فتحنا بدر) we opened Badr(بدر) because it was just a battlefield, it wasn't opened.

But you can say Fath-E-Khaybar(فتح الخيبر) or Fath-E-Makkah(فتح مكه).

You can say Fath-E-Makkah(فتح مكه), that Makkah was opened because there is land that was taken over in the process.

So, this is the differentiating meaning between Fath(فتح) and victory.

So, Fath(فتح) has an additional meaning over victory and that is taking overland.

They were not fearing anyone when that happened in Hajjah-Tul-Wida'a(حجة الوداع), the farewell Hajj(حَجْ).

He knew, what you did not know and has arranged for that a conquest near at hand.

And then Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; It is He, Who send His messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it, over all religion and sufficient is Allah as witness.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ tells us that the religion of Allahعَزّوجَلّ that was sent through Muhammadﷺ and the guidance that was sent with Muhammadﷺ, will manifest over all religion

and then the last Ayah(آية), Allahعَزّوجَلّ says and this is in Ayah(آية) that is continuous virtues for the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says;

Muhammad(محمد) is the Messenger of Allah, and those who are with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves.

Remember, we said that the disbelievers refused to write down Muhammad(محمد) Rasool(رَسول) Allah(الله), that he is the Messenger of Allah, they refused to testify and witnessed that he is the Messenger of Allah.

So, Allah revealed it, in Qur'an that Allah has sent Muhammadﷺ as a Messenger and Muhammad(محمد) is Rasool Ullah(رسول الله) and here we have characteristics of the Sahabah(صحابه).

Number one, they are forceful against the disbelievers, and they are merciful among themselves.

Unfortunately, we find that, there are some Muslims who are the total opposite of this description.

So, they are forceful against the believers and they are very merciful towards the disbelievers.

You see them bowing and prostrating in prayer seeking bounty from Allah and His pleasure.

So, one of the most prominent characteristics is their Salah(صلاة).

You find them, you look at them, you will see that, they are in Sujood(سجود) or they are in Rakooh(ركوع), Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostrations.

So, prostration leaves a trace on the face, it's not talking about the dark mark that is on the forehead it's talking about the light that shines from the face because of Sujood(سجود).

That is their description in the Taurah(توراة).

And their description in the Gospel is, as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them.

So, they grow firm and stand upon their stocks the lighting the sowers, so that He(Allah) may enrage by it, them, the disbelievers.

Allah has promised those, who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

So, the analogy or the similitude of the believers in the Gospel is like a plant that grows until, it is firm and it is unbreakable and that angers the disbelievers.
